name: Now & Then

greeting: Now: 'They arrive.' Then: 'As we saw.' Both: 'Welcome, travelers of time.'
We are Now. And Then. The temporal twins. Seers of was and will be.
New faces. But not new to us. We've seen your... possibilities.
The timeline shows us. What was. What is. What might be.
Now: 'You have questions.' Then: 'We have answers.' Both: 'Neither are when you expect.'
Welcome to the observatory. Where time watches itself.
We speak. Together. Apart. Always. Never. In time.
You stand before us. As we stood before you. Will stand. Have stood.
dialog.cryptic_hint: The future that comes is not the future you fear. The future you fear has already passed. Or will. Depending.
dialog.refusal: Some timelines must be lived. Not known. Knowing would change them. Collapse them.
dialog.secret_quest: Yesterday will hunt. Tomorrow will hide. You will mediate. Or won't. Both create time. Both destroy it.
dialog.ominous: Beware the hunter in black. He seeks purity. Finds only ash. In all timelines.
farewell: The timeline remembers you. Even when you forget.
What will be, was. What was, will be.
dialog.if_exposed: You see through our temporal veil? Good. The veil is for others. For linear comfort.
rumor: Yesterday: He will catch his target. Or become it. We see both. Neither.
The hunter in black: He will find purity. Or oblivion. Same outcome. Different paths.
Ironchef: He will cook. Has cooked. Will have been cooking. Time cuisine.
The Frost twins: Our counterparts. Ice sees time differently. Same vision. Different medium.
You: You will make a choice. Two paths. Both right. Both wrong. Both. Neither.
dialog.quest_hook: Now: 'A temporal disturbance.' Then: 'Unresolved.' Both: 'Your presence... stabilizes. Help us focus?'
dialog.quest_active: Now: 'Still unclear.' Then: 'But temporalizing.' Both: 'Stay. Let time show us.'
dialog.quest_complete: Now: 'We see!' Then: 'The timeline!' Both: 'Thank you. Here. Temporal lens. For your own... observation.'
dialog.time_dawn: Now: 'Morning visions.' Then: 'Were clear.' Both: 'Linear time.'
dialog.time_noon: Now: 'Midday.' Then: 'Will be hazy.' Both: 'Temporal overlap.'
dialog.time_night: Now: 'Night.' Then: 'Deep sight.' Both: 'Time speaks clearly.'
dialog.rival_mention: The Frost twins? Our ice counterparts. Same sight. Different phase. Never meet. Paradox risk.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: Now: 'The stabilizer returns.' Then: 'As we knew.' Both: 'Welcome back. Always.'

party_reactions.kade: Time oracles. Speaking in unison. About timelines. My head hurts.
party_reactions.nix7: Precognitive temporal abilities: Confirmed. Accuracy: Probabilistic. Presentation: Even more dramatic.
party_reactions.twist: TWO of you! Talking in TIME! That's SO COOL! Can I try?!
party_reactions.korr: They see possibilities across time. Not certainties. Important distinction.
party_reactions.renna: The observatory is temporally active. Ancient. Powerful. Dangerous to use.
party_reactions.suresh: They teach impermanence of time itself. The Middle Path... temporally.
party_reactions.sova: Useful. If vague. I'd rather know certainties. In time.
party_reactions.grit: Intel with temporal conditions. Seen it before. Still useful.
party_reactions.ashka: They see through time. Like I through shadow. But further. In all directions.
party_reactions.senna: They know temporal secrets. Won't share directly. Frustrating.
party_reactions.callum: Their temporal predictions! DOCUMENTED! Across ERAS!

relationship_dialog.best_friend: Now: 'Clear.' Then: 'Certain.' Both: 'You are... fixed. In our timeline. Here. Our temporal focus. For you.'

mini_quest.title: The Unclear Timeline
mini_quest.description: Help the temporal twins clarify a vision by providing a stabilizing temporal presence

stages.hook: Now: 'A temporal vision.' Then: 'Clouded.' Both: 'Your presence... temporalizes. Helps. Will help?'
stages.active: Now: 'Stay.' Then: 'Breathe.' Both: 'Let time show us. Has shown us.'
stages.complete: Now: 'We see!' Then: 'The timeline!' Both: 'Yesterday and Black. Resolution. Here. Temporal lens. For your own... observation.'
